# honoka

> A Hono-style web framework for Python 3.13+. Thin core around `Context`, one package per middleware, msgspec validation, OpenAPI. Serves ASGI; host-specific adapters (Cloudflare Workers, ...) are separate packages.

- [README](README.md): quickstart, commands, package list
- [RFC](rfc/honoka-framework-rfc.md): design, API, middleware, roadmap
- [Benchmarks](benchmarks/README.md): method and results
